title: Tuff Speech Model Catalog
description: Root index of every model version this repository publishes. Tools regenerate it; it is never hand-edited. Tuff reads it to discover installable versions and to verify what a local install should contain.

descriptor.description: Repo-relative path to the version descriptor, e.g. models/whisper-base/1.0.0/model.json

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical bundle manifest, so a client can verify the whole version, not just the weights.

default.description: True for the single recommended version of this model id that a fresh install should pick.
